title: DNA Extraction from Canine Feces for Campylobacter jejuni Detection
author: Sara D. Lawhon
materials: MagMaxTM CORE Nucleic Acid Purification Kit

This protocol uses VetMAX Xeno Internal Positive Control ND Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A29762/A29764 as a control for PCR inhibition. Note: This reagent will be added to the MagMAX™ CORE Lysis Solution as a DNA extraction control and/or after DNA extraction is complete to serve as the PCR inhibition control. If the laboratory has a system in place for DNA extraction and PCR inhibition, that method can be substituted in this protocol.

Combine reagents except for the DNA template in a 1.5ml or 2ml microcentrifuge tube and mix well.

In this protocol, you will mix samples with reagents from the MagMax TM CORE Nucleic Acid Purification Kit by either using a plate shaker or by pipetting up and down. If you are using a plate shaker, you will want to determine the maximum setting of your plate shaker prior to running samples.
Extract DNA from the feces using the MagMAX™ CORE Nucleic Acid Purification Kit Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A32700/A32702 following the manufacturer's protocol (outlined below).

The probe is labeled with FAM with Black Hole Quencher 1 (BHQ1) so detection parameters appropriate for FAM or SYBR should be used.The developing laboratory uses Applied Biosystems™ VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control DNA (ThermoFisher Scientific A29762 or A29764) and the VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control - VIC™ Assay (ThermoFisher Scientific A29765 or A29767) to monitor for PCR inhibition.

steps.title: Store fecal samples refrigerated
steps.instruction: Keep all fecal samples at 4 – 8 °C (refrigerated) until they are processed.

steps.title: Process samples within 72 h
steps.instruction: Begin processing each sample no later than 72 hours after receipt in the laboratory.

steps.title: Incubate culture plates (optional)
steps.instruction: If bacterial culture is required, incubate culture plates and enrichment broth in a microaerophilic atmosphere at 42 °C ± 2 °C.

steps.title: Weigh feces and add PBS
steps.instruction: Place exactly 8 g of feces into a 50 mL conical tube and add 32 mL of 1 X PBS (Life Technologies Catalog #10010‑023) to create the feces‑PBS slurry.

steps.title: Vortex slurry and rest
steps.instruction: Vortex the slurry for 30 seconds, then let it sit for 2 minutes (00:02:00) at room temperature.

steps.title: Low‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the slurry at 100 × g, room temperature, for 1 minute.

steps.title: Transfer slurry to microcentrifuge tube
steps.instruction: Pipette 1 mL of the feces‑PBS slurry into a microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Prepare bead‑Proteinase K mix
steps.instruction: For the number of samples plus a 10 % excess, combine per sample: 20 µL MagMAX™ CORE Magnetic Beads and 10 µL MagMAX™ CORE Proteinase K (total 30 µL). Prepare a fresh mix for each run; store at 4 °C for up to 1 week if needed.

steps.title: Resuspend magnetic beads
steps.instruction: Vortex the MagMAX™ CORE Magnetic Beads thoroughly until they are fully resuspended.

steps.title: Prepare lysis solution with IPC
steps.instruction: For the number of samples plus a 10 % excess, combine per sample: 450 µL MagMAX™ CORE Lysis Solution and 4 µL VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control DNA (Thermo Fisher Scientific Catalog #A29762/A29764). Mix by inverting the tube or bottle at least 10 times. Store the lysis solution at room temperature for up to 24 hours.

steps.title: Add lysis solution to clarified lysate
steps.instruction: Add 454 µL of the prepared Lysis Solution to a new 2‑mL tube containing the 200 µL supernatant (clarified lysate) from the low‑speed centrifugation step.

substeps.instruction: Vortex vigorously for 3 minutes (or until the sample is fully suspended).

steps.title: High‑speed centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 15 000 × g, room temperature, for 2 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer clarified lysate to sample plate
steps.instruction: Without disturbing the pellet, transfer 200 µL of the clarified lysate to the wells of the Sample Plate that already contain the bead/Proteinase K mix prepared in step 8.

steps.title: Mix lysate with bead/PK mix
steps.instruction: Incubate the plate at room temperature and mix the clarified lysate with the bead/PK mix for 2 minutes (00:02:00).

steps.title: Add binding solution
steps.instruction: Add 350 µL of MagMAX™ CORE Binding Solution to each well of the Sample Plate containing the lysate‑bead mixture.

steps.title: Run KingFisher extraction
steps.instruction: Load the KingFisher™ Flex instrument with the heated script “MagMAX CORE_Flex.bdz”. Start the run (≈27 minutes).

steps.title: Store or proceed to PCR
steps.instruction: After the KingFisher run, either store the extracted nucleic acid at 4 °C until PCR is performed, or proceed directly to PCR setup.

steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: Using Table 5 (PCR Worksheet), calculate the volumes of each reagent required for the total number of reactions, including one positive control (C. jejuni ATCC 33291, 33292, or 33560), one negative control (E. coli ATCC 25922), and a No‑Template control.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix
steps.instruction: Dispense 18 µL of the prepared master mix into each PCR tube or each well of a PCR plate.

steps.title: Add samples and controls
steps.instruction: To each reaction add the appropriate amount of extracted sample, the positive‑control DNA, the negative‑control DNA, and the VetMAX™ Xeno™ Internal Positive Control (Thermo Fisher Catalog #A29762/A29764).

steps.title: Run thermocycler
steps.instruction: Place the PCR plate or tubes in the thermocycler and run the cycling program specified for the Campylobacter jejuni assay.

steps.title: Interpret Ct values
steps.instruction: Record the Ct value for each reaction. A Ct ≤ 40 is interpreted as positive for C. jejuni; a Ct > 40 or an undetermined Ct is interpreted as negative.

steps.title: Reference primer and probe sequences
steps.instruction: Use the following primers and probe for the gyrA target: gyrA‑F 5’‑AAGATACGGTCGATTTTGTTCCA‑3’; gyrA‑R 5’‑CTACAGCTATACCACTTGAACCATTTAATA‑3’; gyrA‑P 5’‑[FAM]TGATGGTTCAGAAAGCGAACCTGATGTTTT[BHQ1]‑3’.

steps.title: Pre‑use reagent handling
steps.instruction: Before starting, invert all bottles of solutions and buffers to ensure thorough mixing. Wear laboratory gloves, use nuclease‑free pipette tips, and decontaminate benches and pipettes.

steps.title: Prevent cross‑contamination
steps.instruction: Cover plates or tube strips during incubation and shaking steps, and pipet carefully to avoid splashing.

steps.title: Verify shaker compatibility
steps.instruction: Confirm that the plate fits securely on the plate shaker.

steps.title: Test shaker maximum speed
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of water to each well of a test plate, cover with sealing foil, and increase the shaker speed until water begins to splash; set the shaker to a speed just below that point for the protocol.

steps.title: Set up processing plates
steps.instruction: Prepare the following plates for the KingFisher Flex run:

substeps.instruction: Sample Plate – Deep‑well plate (to receive sample‑bead mix).
Wash Plate 1 – Deep‑well plate, add 500 µL MagMAX™ CORE Wash Solution 1 to each well.
Wash Plate 2 – Deep‑well plate, add 500 µL MagMAX™ CORE Wash Solution 2 to each well.
Elution Plate – Standard plate, add 90 µL MagMAX™ CORE Elution Buffer to each well.
Tip Comb – Place a standard tip comb in the plate.

steps.title: Load instrument script
steps.instruction: Prior to running the protocol, load the MagMAX™ CORE script “MagMAX CORE_Flex.bdz” onto the KingFisher Flex instrument.

steps.title: Alternative tube‑based processing
steps.instruction: If processing in tubes (instead of plates), follow these steps:

substeps.instruction: Transfer 200 µL of the supernatant from the low‑speed centrifugation to a microcentrifuge tube.
Add 454 µL of the Lysis Solution, vortex 3 minutes, centrifuge 15 000 × g for 2 minutes.
Transfer 200 µL clarified lysate to a tube containing the bead/PK mix, mix 2 minutes at RT.
Add 350 µL Binding Solution, then place the tube on the KingFisher Flex for the scripted run.

steps.title: Alternative plate‑shaking step
steps.instruction: If using plates before the KingFisher run, after adding the Lysis Solution and vortexing:

substeps.instruction: Seal the plate with sealing foil.
Shake the plate at moderate speed for 5 minutes.
Centrifuge the plate at 3 000 × g, room temperature, for 5 minutes.
Remove the supernatant without disturbing the pellet and transfer 200 µL to the Sample Plate containing the bead/PK mix, then continue with steps 11‑13.
